_doc: Street-grid block fill: grid block r1c5, measured at 28% sprite coverage. It sits between the new d29 retail block and the civic campus (r1c6, already 71%), so it becomes a mixed-use office frontage. NOTE the bbox is 624 wide, not the full 768: the block's east third is NOT empty — a road crosses at world x4112-5088 y1488-1536, and the civic/mainstreet districts already spill in from local x648 (hospital sign, bus shelter, cart corrals, phone booths, dumpster). 624 stops clear of all of it at world x4080. Compile: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/blocks/d32-midtown-offices.json --qa -v. See d29-midtown-retail.json's _layout_doc for the 16px-lattice and 16px-halo rules.
